question: Who won the 2ⁿd LG Cup Ice Hockey Championship 2022 held at the Ice Hockey Rink at NDS Sports Complex in Leh?
solution:
The correct answer is "**Ladakh Scouts Regimental Centre**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The ITBP and **Ladakh Scouts** competed in the finals of the 15th CEC Cup Men's** Ice Hockey Championship, 2022**, at the ice arena located at the **NDS Sports Complex** in Leh.
 
• The 15th CEC Cup Men's Ice Hockey Championship 2022 was ultimately **won **by the Ladakh Scouts.
 
• The winners in the men's and women's divisions of this year's **LG Cup** Ice Hockey Championship received their cups from **Ladakh Lieutenant Governor** RK Mathur.
 
• The competition was put on by the **Leh Department of Youth Services and Sports** in association with the "**Ladakh Winter Sports Club**" of Leh.
